question: Under what celestial conditions should the commencement of initiation be performed?
premises: The commencement of initiation is an action to be undertaken.
Favorable conditions of the moon and stars are specified as relevant.
The text prescribes performing this commencement under such favorable conditions.
inference: Therefore, the commencement of initiation should be performed when the moon and stars are favorable.
uncertainties: The specific astrological criteria defining 'favorable' are not detailed in this verse.
plain_english: And one should perform the commencement of initiation when the moon and stars are favorable.
